cases.title: Starter drops out when START is released
cases.symptom: The conveyor contactor operates only while START is held.
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Visualize hypothetical aux state when coil is commanded
Trace parallel holding branch in revised virtual drawing
Read recorded change log
cases.debrief: The holding path is likely involved, but the specific component remains undetermined until its virtual contact and wiring states are compared with drawings.
cases.safetyBoundary: Never jumper a real stop or seal-in circuit to make it run.

cases.title: Overload alarm on packaging motor
cases.symptom: Overload trips after about twenty minutes under load.
observations: Repeated high load periods before event
No evidence of complete phase loss in log
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Overlay load current trend and operating profile
Review fictional motor and protection device ratings
Compare an approved historical baseline
cases.debrief: Multiple fault hypotheses remain credible. An overload is an indication, not an instruction to increase a setting or repeatedly reset.
cases.safetyBoundary: Do not offer protection changes, live testing or repeated resets as gameplay actions.

cases.title: Dark pilot lamp but running motor
cases.symptom: The motor runs while the green RUN lamp is dark.
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Check virtual branch schematic and commanded lamp state
Compare separate coil and lamp paths
Read maintenance record for lamp replacement
cases.debrief: Lamp state does not establish power state or machine safety. Ask which branch and command condition was documented.
cases.safetyBoundary: A real indicator is never acceptable as the sole absence-of-energy verification.

cases.title: Missing PLC count from proximity sensor
cases.symptom: A sensor LED responds to targets, but the PLC input remains false.
observations: Replacement sensor matches diameter but not catalog suffix
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Inspect virtual catalog output type and input module config
Compare sensor and PLC virtual states
Check modeled terminal-reference mismatch
cases.debrief: A sensor indicator is not end-to-end path proof. An incompatible interface is plausible; exact evidence must differentiate it from cable and input faults.
cases.safetyBoundary: No bypass or bridge of real input contacts or safeguards.

cases.title: Pressure display sticks at zero
cases.symptom: Pressure HMI displays 0 while a separate process value is nonzero.
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Review input channel status and validity flag
Review separate simulated sensor supply state
Compare a historical recording of loop value
cases.debrief: 0 mA is not the expected live zero of a correctly operating standard 4-20 mA loop; it is not enough to claim pressure zero or select one broken component.
cases.safetyBoundary: No physical mA meter wiring instructions or breaking an energized loop.

cases.title: Motor speed below synchronous speed
cases.symptom: A simulated 4-pole 60 Hz motor rotates at 1740 RPM.
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Calculate synchronous speed
Calculate slip
Review load and nameplate context
cases.debrief: 3.33% slip is expected as a calculation; it is not enough evidence to determine a defect.
cases.safetyBoundary: Do not recommend real motor tests or connection changes.

cases.title: Unexpected reverse command rejection
cases.symptom: Operator selects REVERSE, controller says INTERLOCK ACTIVE.
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Review functional sequence chart
Compare modeled contactor feedback to command
Read event timeline and logic state
cases.debrief: An interlock may be correctly blocking an incompatible command; discriminate expected sequencing from false feedback without bypassing it.
cases.safetyBoundary: No real interlock overrides or forced PLC outputs.

cases.title: VFD stopped but work order says electrically safe
cases.symptom: The work request states that a stopped inverter is electrically isolated.
observations: External brake and raised load present
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: List model power and energy-state channels independently
Inspect fictional equipment energy-source map
Review associated safety authorizations
cases.debrief: The safe response is to hold work: a stop command or STO status does not verify isolation or restrain a raised load.
cases.safetyBoundary: No live VFD measurements, discharge shortcuts, or field STO bypass.

cases.title: Panel short-circuit rating mismatch
cases.symptom: Panel data states 5 kA SCCR but site available-fault-current study states 18 kA.
observations: One component marketing sheet advertises 65 kA
candidateCauses: Assembly may be unsuitable for site
Site study could refer to wrong equipment
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Check revision and location of available-fault-current record
Compare panel marking to approved build docs
List missing assembly determination evidence
cases.debrief: Hold approval pending responsible engineering evaluation; a 65 kA device alone cannot establish the complete panel SCCR.
cases.safetyBoundary: No ad hoc breaker substitution, setting increase, or claimed certification.

cases.title: Transformer feeds not accounted for
cases.symptom: Primary feeder disconnected in scenario, yet an indicator remains on.
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Map all fictional source paths
Compare primary/secondary power model
Review current drawing revision
cases.debrief: Source mapping matters more than assuming one disconnect controls the entire cabinet.
cases.safetyBoundary: No claim that indicator status verifies absence of energy.

cases.title: Once-per-shift encoder fault
cases.symptom: An encoder error occurs during warm shifts on a rotating assembly.
observations: Fault events cluster after long run time
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Align logs by timestamps and loading
Review documentation for routing changes
Separate cable electrical behavior and motion feedback evidence
cases.debrief: Retain several hypotheses. Correlation warrants focused investigation but is not a verified cause; record validation window.
cases.safetyBoundary: No energized waveform probing or bypass of feedback protection.

cases.title: Incomplete cabinet bonding record
cases.symptom: A fictional panel passes a visual review but bonding documentation is missing.
observations: Green conductor present without termination record
discriminatingVirtualEvidence: Compare schematic and assembly inspection packet
Identify uncertain mechanical interfaces
Request appropriate acceptance record
cases.debrief: An unverified critical protective path must remain unresolved; appearance and paperwork checks alone cannot prove integrity.
cases.safetyBoundary: No live grounding checks or field bonding sizes supplied.
